items.title: Summit at UC Merced Takes Aim at Preserving Grasslands
items.summary: By Patty Guerra, UC Merced October 29, 2026 The state is working to support the restoration of grasslands, Agriculture Secretary Karen Ross said. Photo by Sara Nevis California's grasslands are a vital part of a healthy ecosystem, supporting native plants and endangered animal species. Yet the vast majority of them - more than 90 percent - have been lost to development and invasive non-native plan
